users.title: Users
users.description: Every member with access to this tenant. Register newcomers, review status, and manage roles.

users.registeredDesc: An email confirmation may be required before sign-in.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username, or email…
users.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the filters.
users.emptyFiltersBody: No users match the current filters.
users.emptyBody: Register the first member to seed this tenant. They'll receive a confirmation email if email confirmation is enabled.

detail.impersonateDesc: You'll act as this user across the dashboard. Every action you take will be attributed to them in audit logs (with your operator id preserved as the actor). End impersonation from the banner at the top of the page when you're done.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: System-level permission sets. Users inherit all permissions from their assigned roles.
roles.createDesc: Roles group permissions. Assign users to roles to grant access.
roles.editDesc: Update the name and description. Permission changes apply immediately.

roles.rootPermissionTitle: Root-level permission. May be filtered server-side.

roles.descriptionPlaceholder: Can manage users and assign roles

detail.detailsDesc: The display label and a one-line summary admins will see at assignment time.
